title: Villa Xaac
subtitle: The elegance of a minimalist retreat bathed in tropical light
description:
Ideally located in the heart of Puerto Aventuras, Villa Xaac is a contemporary masterpiece built in 2017 that perfectly balances architectural boldness with tropical comfort. The residence stands out for its impressive double-height ceilings and a minimalist interior design where light and stone textures harmonize. Designed for those who seek a lifestyle of effortless elegance, the home opens entirely toward its lush private garden, dissolving the boundaries between indoors and outdoors.

Architectural Volume and Design
The living space of 4,832 square feet is structured around a spectacular open-plan layout. The ground floor features a gourmet kitchen with a central island and a walk-in pantry, flowing seamlessly into a vast dining and living area. The upper level, accessible via a light-filled gallery, houses the private quarters where noble wood finishes and glass railings maintain a sense of absolute transparency and flow. The home has four bedrooms, three full bathrooms and two half baths.

Outdoor Sanctuary
The exterior is designed as a private oasis for relaxation and high-end entertaining. A deep shaded terrace, featuring a professional-grade custom outdoor kitchen and bar, faces a sculptural swimming pool surrounded by mature tropical greenery. This intimate sanctuary is perfect for long afternoons under the Caribbean sky, offering complete privacy within the secure community of Puerto Aventuras.

Sustainability and Comfort
True luxury is defined by the absence of friction and environmental consciousness. Villa Xaac operates with remarkable efficiency, powered by a 14-panel solar system. Every detail, from the three dedicated parking spaces to the refined walk-in closets, has been meticulously planned to ensure a seamless living experience.
